decisions.reason: As a training offer tightly linked to the installed base and service model, it supports customer retention and machine utilization, so we would likely continue it.
The fourth rotary axis accessory extends existing milling systems at relatively low risk and fits the firm's modular, application-driven portfolio, so it is worth keeping.

Because hybrid additive post-processing is comparatively distant from the core offer and was only lightly presented, we would be more likely to withdraw it and refocus resources on stronger adjacent products.
A high-speed CNC milling machine is central to the firm's core competence, innovation profile, and customer demand for productive precision equipment, so we would keep it on the market.
The automatic tool change system directly improves productivity and complements the firm's machinery and workflow support, making it a strong candidate to remain in the portfolio.
